title: p-map
summary: A public promise-aware concurrent mapping utility.
intended_users: JavaScript developers needing bounded asynchronous concurrency and backpressure.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Map asynchronous work with bounded concurrency and predictable errors.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: Promise.all is simpler but does not bound concurrency or expose the same backpressure controls.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Provide a focused mapping API and streaming variant with explicit concurrency, stop-on-error, and backpressure options.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The narrow package delegates scheduling and cancellation limits to JavaScript runtime semantics.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed concurrency, error, abort, iterator, and backpressure tests without execution.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Revisit API boundaries when platform primitives cover the same behavior.

testing_strategy: Committed tests cover concurrency, errors, aborts, iterables, and backpressure; Finch never executes them.
security_threat: Security is not the selected track and should not be overclaimed.
production_limitation: Static review cannot establish runtime behavior, performance, or test success.
technical_debt: Runtime-specific edge cases require downstream evaluation.
track_alignment_explanation: A licensed, documented reusable package is the project's primary purpose.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No upstream AI-use claim; calibration narrative only.
